_doc: Runner mini-game (Survival > Runner: Walk & Fight). units: runner stats per locked battle rig (roster = LockedBattleRoster name; hp, damage per attack, cycle = seconds between attacks; for squad units it is the asked-for interval: the battle attack take is sped up so one take lasts one cycle, the shot leaving on the take's release frame, capped at 2.5x speed (RunnerAttackTiming), which stretches the interval to take / 2.5 (squad shots fly straight down the road from the shooter's lane: steering is the aim), range m, ranged shots fly at shot_speed m/s, speed = enemy walk-in m/s, 0 = holds its ground, radius m). levels: spawn rows by distance 'at' metres down the lane; x = metres from the centre line (+ right). enemy rows spawn 'count' units 'spread' m apart; box rows have hp and a reward (followers: count copies of unit, hero: one new hero, weapon: +amount damage, rate: +amount attack speed, range: +amount shot range, heal: +amount of the hero's max hp); scale (optional, default 1) sizes an enemy in the runner, body radius included (radius is the unscaled body); hazard rows are lane traps the squad steers round (hazard: spikes | log | fire, width m, damage to the hero, phase s; a trap it catches takes 40% of that damage off a follower's 25 HP, never all of it in one go); a boss row ends the level (kill it to win). Without a boss, reaching 'length' wins.

spread._doc: Derek 2026-11-20: too much downtime, big clumps then long lulls. From Level 'from' on (1: every level; Levels 1-'early.until' use the milder early pack / window, Level 1 its own first_window, so the opening stays gentle), every wave row before the boss guard / finale is cut into packs of at most 'pack' enemies and the packs reach the squad at an even rhythm from the level's first enemy to its last (same units, order and lanes; each pack moved up to 'jitter' of a step). RunnerSpreadDef; Docs/runner_balance.md.

crowd._doc: Derek 2026-11-20 (more enemies): every wave row before the boss guard / finale carries at least count x its enemies (extra ones are spread into the stream with the rest; boss guard and finale keep their size), each enemy at foe_hp x its HP and foe_dmg x its damage; a crowd enemy's hit on a follower is its no-crowd hit capped at a follower's HP times foe_dmg, so followers also take the cut (RunnerRules.CrowdFollowerHit). Kill gold per kill is shared so a level pays the same. level_tweaks foe_hp re-fitted per level for the free pace. RunnerSpreadDef; Docs/runner_balance.md.

lanes._doc: Derek 2026-11-20 ("more enemies need to come from the outside of the lanes and stay there ... the same for powerups"; "the wolves for example move to the center too quickly"; "some enemies can spawn in from the side ... with enough time to kill"). After the stream is laid out: an even 'outer' share of its enemy packs stand on an outer lane ('outer_x' m from the centre, sides mostly alternating) and hold it (no drift toward the hero); 'side' of all stream packs (taken from the outer ones, 'side_units' only) instead walk in from 'side_out' m beyond the road edge at 'side_speed' m/s or faster, so they are on the road at least 'side_min_s' s before they can hit the squad; an even 'crates' share of the power-up crates move out to 'crate_x' m. Enemies left inside drift toward the hero at 'seek' m/s per unit (others RunnerRules.EnemySeek 0.55). RunnerLanesDef; Docs/runner_balance.md.

progression._boss_doc: A big boss only ends Levels 5, 10, 15, ... 50. Every 10th (L10, L20, L30, L40, L50) is Vorgath; the other boss levels stay Ironhowl. The rest end on the last wave and the finish line. Vorgath's runner numbers match Ironhowl's so the free-pace sim does not move; he reads larger from his battle scale.
progression._ramp_doc: Levels past from (12) stop getting longer past length_cap and stop adding enemies / boxes past count_cap; instead every level multiplies enemy HP, enemy damage and boss HP by the growth, and every level past wall_from (30) by the steeper wall growth. Balanced by tests/Survival.Domain.Tests/RunnerBalanceTests.cs (see Docs/runner_balance.md): a free player with normal upgrades clears 1-30, 31-50 need bought upgrades.

level_tweaks._doc: Hand adjustments to single generated levels (RunnerLevelTweak; all default 1.0 / 0): wave = enemies per wave group, foe_hp = enemy HP, barrier_hp = barrier HP, layout = re-roll where the beats start and which set piece each is (what each beat holds stays the same). The levels below re-roll their layout where the first roll made them much harder or easier than their neighbours, so no level needs more than 1.6x the power of the one before and Levels 1-12 need no upgrades (Derek 2026-10-27). Re-picked after the tougher barriers and traps and Lyra's 420 -> 320 HP, and again after the power-up crates moved (Oct 27; Docs/runner_balance.md). foe_hp on Levels 15-50 re-fitted after the longer run-up before each level's first row (first_run_up, Oct 29) so the free pace stays locked; foe_hp on Levels 2-12 raised so the opening keeps main's difficulty with the same 5 m run-up (re-fitted from 6 m, Oct 29). Levels 1-20 foe HP then x1.5 (Derek Oct 29: the early levels felt far too easy; Level 1 via its own 1 entry, which only touches Level 1). foe_hp on Levels 31-34, 36, 42, 44 and 46-50 re-fitted (Nov 9) to restore the locked free pace (RunnerFreePaceTests: wall L31, L31 day 13, L50 day ~829) after #105 (2-hit ranged shots + shot-dodging sim player), #128 (Ashwyrm 3.6 m reach) and #162/#164 had moved free L31 to day 220 and L46/L50 out of reach. foe_hp on Levels 1-12 lowered (Derek Nov 16: Level 2 was almost impossible without upgrading units): an untrained squad (scale 1) now wins Levels 1-9 and 11 in the sim, needing L1 0.41 / L2 0.58 / L3 0.57 / L4 0.66 / L5 0.91 / L6 0.89 / L7 0.82 / L8 0.96 of its power (was 0.54 / 1.06 / 1.06 / 0.84 / 1.06 / 1.13 / 1.02 / 1.22); total enemy HP still climbs every level, enemy counts, gold and rewards are unchanged, so the free pace is untouched. L4 1.1, L7 1.1, L10 1.3, L11 1.2 and L12 1.4 are picked so Vespera casts never need a sped-up take and no follower joins only to die that frame (VesperaWalkCastHandsTests, RunnerEveryoneAttacksTests); no Level 1-12 entry is exactly 1.0, which RunnerTests reads as untuned and L1 1.3 so a recruited Oakenshield still joins on Level 1 (RunnerOwnershipTests). foe_hp and layout re-fitted on Levels 13-50 (Derek Nov 20; Levels 2-12 keep main's entries, unspread) after the waves were spread down the road (progression spread), so each level needs the same power as on main (within 2% on every level) and the free pace stays locked (wall L31, L46 day 489, L50 day ~829). foe_hp and layout on Levels 1-12 re-fitted again (Derek Nov 20) when the spread (progression spread, early) reached them: required power within 2% of main (Level 1 +2.2%), total enemy HP still climbing every level, enemy counts unchanged. foe_hp on every level re-fitted again (Nov 20) after spread.lanes (outer lanes, side entries, outer crates) so the free pace stays locked; 'lanes' (default 0) re-rolls a level's outer-lane picks (used on 5, 11-14, 16, 18, 23, 29 where the first roll moved the required power in steps HP could not pay back).
